lines.sentence: Compared to many of your chaotic journeys, this one hasn’t been too devastating. As a matter of fact the empty plains you’re on now are almost calming.
Please! You have to help me! There’s a man that just broke into my house!
Okay, a person comes in front of you, pointing to their house out across the field. The door is smashed open.

choices.choiceText: I'm sorry, but I'm not a town guard. I can't help you.

lines.sentence: Walking into the building, the silence is more prevalent than any danger-
